correctness.rationale: Commutation gives an exact unique normal form and a checked associative composition law. Constructed generators yield arbitrary zero-fixing maps via positive collapses and deletions; three exhaustive cases handle every possible nonzero image of the special block; single-source bit masks finish. Lower bound separates unit-group rank and three distinct first-critical nonunit factor types. Independent finite full-map enumeration confirms b=1..4, with b=2 exhaustive smaller-generator exclusion.

originality.rationale: Primary 2014 full manuscript identifies the mixed section-preserving regular centralizer-rank task as a natural open problem. Its partition-preserving rank formula is for a larger monoid. The closest published modern theorem covers uniform wreath products, not one singleton plus doubleton blocks. Five actual published-finding corpus searches plus targeted title and full-text searches found no equivalent statement. Both 2004 and 2011 earlier papers were only partially accessible, leaving explicit nonzero priority risk.
residual_risks: The 2004 and 2011 same-object original full articles could contain a previously overlooked equivalent special rank formula.
A more general modern characterization of nonuniform cross-section-preserving generator rank may exist under a different terminology not recovered by semantic or full-text searches.

value.rationale: The family is the first mixed block type after uniform doubletons in a published rank problem for regular idempotent centralizers. Exact minimal ranks for infinitely many degrees and structural explicit optimal generators are useful semigroup invariants, with the singleton requiring an additional nonunit mechanism absent in the uniform wreath situation.
